label: The lingering shadow of epidemics: post-acute sequelae across history.
summary: The SARS-CoV-2 pandemic has drawn global attention to post-acute infection syndromes (PAIS), with millions affected by post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 (PASC, or Long COVID). While Long COVID is newly defined, PAIS have been described for over a century following epidemic infections. Multiple pathogens - including influenza, Epstein-Barr virus, and Borrelia burgdorferi, among others - can precipitate persistent, poorly understood symptoms.
